title: AdvancedBlockIndicator
description: A plugin which shows a useful tool tip of the block the player is looking at: the name of the block / if the player can mine blocks (the block will drop) / with what tool
body:
**This plugin adds an Advanced Block Indicator mode for every player.**
**It can be activated using the command ``` /ShowAdvancedBlockTips . ```, which requires operator!**

When activated, it shows you the _name_ of the block you are hovering over, a ✔ or a ❌ depending on if the block will drop with your current tool and also indicate what _tool_ you need to break the specified block, along with the minimum _material_ tier required for it to drop an item. > Tools include pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, shears, hand
> Material tiers include pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, shears, hand, unbreakable **Examples are included in the gallery**
